final: SELECT AVG(category_avg_relative_overspend) AS average_relative_overspend, AVG(line_count) AS average_budget_lines, AVG(line_count) - (SELECT AVG(category_line_count) FROM (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS category_line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category)) AS average_lines_above_per_category_average FROM (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS line_count, AVG(1.0 * (spent - amount) / amount) AS category_avg_relative_overspend FROM budget GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(category_line_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS category_line_count FROM budget GROUP BY category)))
